subject.title: Add an "Approve and Run" action for assistant-suggested terminal commands in the Control UI

question: Should Control UI support assistant-suggested command execution, and what typed proposal/approval contract should bind command text, cwd, host, risk labels, session context, and output streaming?
rationale: This feature creates a new assistant-output-to-local-command execution path, so maintainers need to choose the product and security contract before an implementation PR is safe.

options.title: Design typed command proposals first
options.body: Add the UX only after defining structured command proposals that reuse existing Gateway approval records and reject mutated command context.

options.title: Keep assistant commands copy-only
options.body: Leave assistant-rendered shell snippets as copy-only markdown until the execution model has stronger product/security backing.

options.title: Fold into dashboard approval work
options.body: Let the pending-approvals dashboard/widget direction establish shared approval UX first, then add assistant command proposals as a follow-up.

recommendation.title: Design typed command proposals first
recommendation.body: Add the UX only after defining structured command proposals that reuse existing Gateway approval records and reject mutated command context.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history across exec approval contracts, Control UI chat rendering, and approval security direction.
